programme.title: World's Most Amazing Walks
programme.desc: Robson Green gained popularity, among others, thanks to the role of an experienced detective in the crime series "Grantchester".Privately, the actor is a great lover of hiking and fishing.The new series documents eight expeditions along selected tourist routes in Europe.The artist traveled, among others, the northern coast of Normandy, following in the footsteps of soldiers taking part in a key battle of World War II.On the Trail of the Eagles' Nests in Poland, he had the opportunity to admire impressive landscapes and the ruins of medieval castles.A monument to a bygone era. programme.title: Dynasties II
programme.desc: The authors present the fate of wild animals that, living in often difficult conditions, persistently fight for the survival of their families.Each episode concerns a representative of a different species and members of its herd.Viewers will learn, among others:the story of the eight-year-old cheetah Kali, a resident of the grassy plains in western Zambia.Despite her relatively old age, the female desperately protects her family, teaching her daughters to be independent.A resident of Kenya, an inexperienced elephant, tries to secure the existence of her twins and unite the herd after the death of the leader.A puma from Patagonia takes care of four cubs alone.The program also features croquettes, the females of which are fighting an internal fight for dominance, as well as a young meerkat queen and Mac the macaque, trying to maintain his dominant role in the herd and father an offspring, thus initiating his own monkey dynasty. Against the backdrop of pristine corners of the Earth - from harsh Patagonia to African savannahs - various animal families fight for survival.Parents must pass on to their offspring skills that will influence their lives.Produced on an impressive scale, the series presents the adventures of animal clans, devoting each episode to different characters.Representatives of the fauna kingdom are shown through the prism of human behavior - they fight fiercely for power, build alliances, look for partners and provide their children with a school of life.And all this takes place against the background of phenomenal landscapes from the farthest corners of the globe.In the land of meerkats This time, the filmmakers go to Botswana, where a multi-generational herd of meerkats lives in the hot and dry climate of the Makgadikgadi salt flats.The ruler, who was named Maghogho, must unite her family so that her young can survive in an extremely hostile environment.However, she lacks experience, so she works by trial and error.In moments of danger, she sometimes makes bad decisions.Fate puts many challenges before her - from problems with a gang of rivals to violent storms.There are plenty of suspenseful moments in this bittersweet story.However, the herd of little ones has a chance to survive thanks to the strong bond that unites them.

programme.title: Spy in the Ocean
programme.desc: The creators of the four-episode series present the journey of specially constructed animal replicas equipped with cameras to the ocean.Their goal is to bring closer the deeply hidden life of creatures inhabiting this inaccessible and dynamic ecosystem.Using breakthrough technology, including:modern LCD screens, record surprising behaviors and relationships of sea animals.Viewers will see colorful coral reefs, rocky coastlines, Thai macaques fishing, unusual behavior of seals, socialization of sperm whales and a complicated ritual between hermit crabs.The over thirty spies include a sperm whale, a herring, a puffer, a hermit crab, a clownfish and a dolphin.The production took three years on four oceans of the world Filmmakers used new technologies to present the magic of the underwater world from a previously unavailable perspective.Robots equipped with cameras - confusingly similar to sea animals - set off on a spy mission.They not only passively recorded their surroundings, but also interacted with representatives of various species.The spectacular recordings were made into a documentary series that combines a fascinating narrative with impressive photos and humor.Its characters include sperm whales, octopuses, macaques, puffers, crabs and marlins.Underwater Geniuses One of the robotic spies took the form of a baby sperm whale.Not only cameras were installed there, but also hydrophones recording sounds.The three-meter-long baby was supposed to arouse the maternal instinct of the female it encountered.It greeted him with characteristic clicks.The moving meeting scene gave insight into the social intelligence of these giants.On an isolated Thai island, a dummy monkey spied on a diving flock of macaques.Cameras recorded their clever use of tools and carefree fun.In turn, the mechanical cephalopod went to meet the coconut octopus.Their interaction showed that true geniuses live in depths inaccessible to man.

programme.desc: Antarctica is the coldest and windiest continent.The climate here is harsh, and only the toughest can survive.From Weddell seals crushing the ice with their teeth, to colorful starfish covering the seabed hidden under the ice.Penguin chicks may lose their lives when confronted by killer whales and leopard seals.Meanwhile, starfish and huge worms line the seabed as a feeding spectacle takes place on the surface.Life comes to Antarctica because the ocean surrounding the continent is extremely rich.Thousands of penguins, seals, albatrosses and over a hundred huge whales feast on the krill schools.Unfortunately, the local waters are warming, and as the temperature increases, the future of the local fauna and flora looks more and more uncertain.
